study type: Prognostic model development and external validation study
cohort: The study participants included 622 singleton pregnancies diagnosed with fetal growth restriction (FGR) from two hospitals in China.
finding: The developed nomogram demonstrated good predictive performance (C-index 0.776-0.92) for adverse perinatal outcomes, including termination of pregnancy and stillbirth, in singleton FGR pregnancies.
mod_finding: A history of caesarean section was identified as an independent prognostic factor for adverse perinatal outcomes.
followup_time: Follow-up was until the 34th gestation week or the occurrence of an adverse perinatal outcome within the current pregnancy.
birth_weight: N/A (focuses on FGR, but no specific weight range mentioned)
gest_age: N/A (predictions are made for outcomes up to 28 and 34 weeks gestation, but initial gest_age of cohort not specified)
